headline: Upgrade picks per-case guides; codemod runs only on major crossings
reason: Changes which guide files are copied, when the codemod runs, and the agent prompt text, all of which alter runtime behavior of the upgrade command.
risk_signals: codemod now runs only when major version changes
new file copy logic with fs errors aborting preparation
agent prompt wording and Future Defaults handling changed
focus: bundled docs contain shared.md, same-major.md, different-major.md, future-defaults.md and codemods.md at the copied paths (the cp calls fail otherwise)
version-N.md exists for every crossed major in the router chosen by version < 14, and Pages codemods.md exists when installed major < 13
same-major updates, including canary to canary, no longer run the codemod and rely on the agent to install the version
future policy with no pending defaults and a version change gets the guide plus the 'No Future Defaults are pending adoption.' prompt
summary: spawnNextUpgrade now splits the single agentic-upgrade guide into shared, same-major, different-major and future-defaults guides and copies only the needed docs, including per-major version guides, into the temp directory. The codemod bootstrap now runs only when the major version changes, and the prompt and Future Defaults instructions are reworked to point at the new guides.
